title: ReviewService Phase 3 - Public Queries, Summary and Core MVP Release

tasks.title: Domain and Repository Query Extensions for Public and Summary Queries
tasks.description:
Extend IReviewRepository and ReviewRepository in ReviewService/src/Domain to support public listing reviews, public supplier reviews, my reviews, and rating summary calculations:
1. GetPublicListingReviewsAsync(Guid listingId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken ct):
   - Filter: direction == renter_to_supplier_listing && authorState == Active && moderationState == Visible && equipmentListingId == listingId.
   - Order: CreatedAt DESC, Id DESC.
   - Pagination: Skip((page - 1) * pageSize).Take(pageSize). Returns (IReadOnlyList<Review> Items, int TotalCount).
2. GetPublicSupplierReviewsAsync(Guid supplierId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken ct):
   - Filter: direction == renter_to_supplier_listing && authorState == Active && moderationState == Visible && subjectId == supplierId.
   - Order: CreatedAt DESC, Id DESC.
   - Pagination: Skip((page - 1) * pageSize).Take(pageSize). Returns (IReadOnlyList<Review> Items, int TotalCount).
3. GetMyReviewsAsync(Guid authorId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken ct):
   - Filter: authorId == authorId (includes Active and Withdrawn reviews).
   - Order: CreatedAt DESC, Id DESC.
   - Pagination: Skip((page - 1) * pageSize).Take(pageSize). Returns (IReadOnlyList<Review> Items, int TotalCount).
4. GetRatingSummaryAsync(string targetType, Guid targetId, CancellationToken ct):
   - TargetType 'listing': equipmentListingId == targetId. TargetType 'supplier': subjectId == targetId.
   - Filter: direction == renter_to_supplier_listing && authorState == Active && moderationState == Visible.
   - Returns (int TotalCount, double? AverageRating, Dictionary<int, int> Distribution).
   - When TotalCount == 0, AverageRating is null and all distribution keys 1..5 have count 0.
   - AverageRating rounded AwayFromZero to 1 decimal place.
5. Unit tests in ReviewService/tests/Api.Tests/RepositoriesTests.cs covering query filters and summary calculations.
acceptance_criteria: IReviewRepository and ReviewRepository implement public listing, supplier, my reviews, and rating summary queries
Public query filter strictly enforces direction=renter_to_supplier_listing, authorState=Active, moderationState=Visible
Summary calculation returns null average when count is 0 and full 1..5 distribution
Repository unit tests pass with dotnet test ReviewService.sln

tasks.title: Application Layer Query DTOs, Mapping and ReviewService Query Methods
tasks.description:
Implement DTOs and query workflows in ReviewService/src/Application:
1. DTOs in ReviewService/src/Application/DTOs/Reviews:
   - PublicReviewItemResponse (Guid ReviewId, int Rating, string? Comment, DateTimeOffset CreatedAt, DateTimeOffset? UpdatedAt, string AuthorMaskedName = "Khách hàng")
   - ReviewSummaryResponse (string TargetType, Guid TargetId, double? AverageRating, int ReviewCount, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> RatingDistribution)
   - PagedResult<T> in ReviewService/src/Application/DTOs/Common or Reviews (IReadOnlyList<T> Items, int Page, int PageSize, int TotalCount, int TotalPages)
2. IReviewService and ReviewService in ReviewService/src/Application/Services:
   - GetListingReviewsAsync(Guid listingId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken ct)
   - GetSupplierReviewsAsync(Guid supplierId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken ct)
   - GetMyReviewsAsync(Guid actorId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken ct)
   - GetSummaryAsync(string targetType, Guid targetId, CancellationToken ct): validates targetType is 'listing' or 'supplier' (case-insensitive), returns Error.Validation if invalid. If target has no reviews, returns count 0, average null, distribution 1..5 as 0s (never returns 404).
3. Unit tests in ReviewService/tests/Api.Tests/ApplicationDtoTests.cs verifying serialization matches fixtures public-listing-reviews-response.json, review-summary-response.json, review-summary-empty-response.json.
acceptance_criteria: PublicReviewItemResponse, ReviewSummaryResponse, PagedResult DTOs conform strictly to docs/contracts/review-api-v1.md
AuthorMaskedName defaults to neutral label 'Khách hàng'
IReviewService and ReviewService implement all 4 query use cases
DTO serialization tests pass with dotnet test ReviewService.sln

tasks.title: ReviewsController Endpoints and Acceptance Tests for Public Queries and Summary
tasks.description:
Expose public and personal query endpoints in ReviewsController and implement comprehensive acceptance test suite:
1. Endpoints in ReviewService/src/Api/Controllers/ReviewsController.cs:
   - GET /api/v1/reviews/my: [Authorize], reads actorId from JWT sub, accepts page (default 1), pageSize (default 20, max 50). Returns 200 OK with PagedResult<ReviewDetailResponse>.
   - GET /api/v1/reviews/listings/{listingId}: [AllowAnonymous], accepts page, pageSize. Returns 200 OK with PagedResult<PublicReviewItemResponse>.
   - GET /api/v1/reviews/suppliers/{supplierId}: [AllowAnonymous], accepts page, pageSize. Returns 200 OK with PagedResult<PublicReviewItemResponse>.
   - GET /api/v1/reviews/summary?targetType=listing|supplier&targetId={UUID}: [AllowAnonymous], validates query params. Returns 200 OK with ReviewSummaryResponse.
2. Acceptance Tests in ReviewService/tests/Api.Tests/PublicReviewsAndSummaryTests.cs covering:
   - GET /reviews/listings/{id} returns only Active+Visible reviews, hides Withdrawn, hides Hidden, hides supplier_to_renter, masks author as 'Khách hàng'
   - GET /reviews/suppliers/{id} returns supplier reviews correctly
   - Target with 0 reviews returns empty list with 200 OK (not 404)
   - GET /reviews/summary returns exact average rating, review count, and full 1..5 distribution
   - GET /reviews/summary on empty target returns 200 OK with count 0, averageRating null, all distribution keys 0
   - GET /reviews/summary with invalid targetType returns 400 Bad Request
   - GET /reviews/my without JWT returns 401 Unauthorized
   - GET /reviews/my with JWT returns user's reviews including Withdrawn
   - Pagination parameters (page, pageSize) are validated and respected
3. Confirm all existing 85 tests continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: Public endpoints are accessible anonymously while /my requires authentication
All acceptance tests in PublicReviewsAndSummaryTests pass cleanly
Full test suite passes with dotnet test ReviewService.sln
